findings.title: architecture.md claims pricing/stock import each other; stock does not

evidence.quote:
`src/cart` owns items and totals, `src/checkout` owns the flow. Pricing and
stock currently import each other through `src/cart/stock.ts`.

findings.note: stock.ts imports from cart.ts, not from pricing.ts, so pricing and stock do not import each other; the real cycle is pricing -> stock -> cart -> pricing, which the doc does not describe. Doc is also flagged 582 days stale.

findings.title: README has no CHANGELOG despite tagged/versioned releases

evidence.quote:
# web-ts

Cart and checkout front end.

    npm test

findings.note: Package is versioned (1.1.0, a tagged v1.0.0 release exists) and has an active CI pipeline, but the repo has no CHANGELOG, CONTRIBUTING, or ADR directory documenting releases or contribution process; README covers neither.

looks_bad_but_fine.why: npm test matches package.json scripts.test (jest) and the CI workflow command, so the documented example still runs as written.

not_assessed: README.md and docs/architecture.md staleness in days (582) is taken from provided signals, not independently verified via git log since no shell/git tool was available in this session
Whether v1.0.0 tag or version bump commits represent a formal release process was not verified beyond the git tag ref and package.json version field
